title: Bring in past OPay terminal payments
summary: Ask OPay for a terminal's successful payments between two days (up to a week) and add them to the POS sales table.
description: Run it from the web app or by chat with a terminal's serial number and two days at most a week apart: Taskiem asks OPay for every successful payment on that terminal in those days and adds them to your POS sales table, then tells you how many came in. Use it when you start, to have last week's figures, or after a day the notifications were down. A payment already in the table is recognised by its reference, so running it twice counts nothing twice.

params.title: POS sales table
params.description: The table the recording workflows write to.

tables.description: Every transaction your terminals make, one row per event the provider sends. Amounts are in naira; fee and settled are filled when the provider reports them (OPay does, Moniepoint does not).
